meta.title: Oh! — music tools, starting with Oh a Chord
meta.description: Oh! makes music software: Oh a Chord, an iPad instrument where one key press plays a full chord, out now on the App Store. Two more on the way.

hero.line: Music tools from one person who makes records with them. First out: Oh a Chord — press one key, get a full chord — now on the App Store.

chord.status: Out now on the App Store
chord.headline: Press one key. Get a full chord.
chord.body: A one-octave iPad keyboard where a single key press plays a whole chord. Chord Type and Modifier buttons set its colour, Key Mode keeps every press inside the key you pick, and a held chord becomes a strum, a harp sweep, or an arpeggio. No music theory required.
chord.mediaCaption: Oh a Chord on iPad — chord controls under your left hand, keyboard under your right.

comingSoon.heading: Also on the way
comingSoon.body: Two more tools are in progress. Leave your email against either one and you'll hear when it ships — one message per launch, nothing else.

synth.blurb: A 6-voice polysynth inspired by the classic sounds of the 80s.
synth.mailtoLabel: Tell me when Oh a Synth ships

comber.blurb: A sample organizer that makes every sample you already own findable — without moving a file.
comber.mailtoLabel: Tell me when Oh a Comber ships

maker.heading: Who makes this
maker.body: Oh! is Nate Mueller — designer, developer, and the first user of everything here. Records music as Oacoma.
